output.headline: Amends Achieve Academy's Prop 39 facilities agreement to let EPIC temporarily share its Hawthorne space
output.summary: The board is approving an amendment to the agreement under which Achieve Academy, a charter school, uses district space under Proposition 39 (the state law on sharing facilities with charter schools). The amendment lets EPIC temporarily share Achieve Academy's existing space at the Hawthorne campus for July 1, 2019 to June 30, 2020. No dollar amount is stated.

output.summary: Kruger International will furnish and install 12 workstations for the kitchen of the new Central Commissary Building, as part of the Foster the Center project. The limit of $36,002.77 includes a $3,000 contingency (a cushion for unexpected costs). The work was scheduled to start December 12, 2019, before this approval.

output.summary: The district becomes an active member of a coalition of nonprofit, community and direct-service groups working so that every Oakland child learns and loves to read. Membership is for up to four years from approval and costs the district nothing.

output.summary: The Board is asked to declare a district vehicle, listed in an attached exhibit, obsolete and surplus. This lets the district dispose of it under state education law. The text does not state a dollar amount or a disposal date.
